body.text: President Volodymyr Zelensky told reporters that U.S. negotiators have floated the idea of Ukraine ceding the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

body.text: The White Coat Ceremony took place this afternoon at the Scuola Grande San Giovanni Evangelista in Venice, organised by UniCamillus – Università Medica Internazionale di Roma.
Fourth‑year medical students received the white coat and recited the “Dichiarazione di Ginevra”, symbolically assuming their ethical and professional commitment.
Deputy mayor Francesca Zaccariotto addressed the students and their families with a greeting.

why_it_matters.text: The ceremony highlights Venice’s support for medical education and the ethical formation of future doctors.
